_readme: Every entry point anyone may call, on the Diamond and on the contracts shipped beside it, with what backs it (#2984).
Checked by contracts/script/check-permissionless-steps.mjs (predeploy-check step 1e; the keeper typecheck runs its --ledger-only half). Its header defines each class.
An open entry point with no row fails the check, and so does a row for a function that is gated or gone. Add a row with the function that adds the entry point.

AggregatorAdapterImplementation.initiali.why: the deployment, or the Diamond's factory, initializes each proxy once in the transaction that creates it

MulticallFacet.multicall(struct:Multical.why: runs the caller's own calls as the caller (delegatecall keeps msg.sender); each inner call keeps its own gate

OfferCancelFacet.cancelOffer(uint256).why: the creator cancels its own offer; anyone may cancel an expired offer (refund to the creator, no keeper owed) or a vehicle offer whose route is dead (#3336), which the keeper sweeps

SignedOfferMatchFacet.matchSignedOffer(s.why: matches an off-chain signed offer the matcher does not index; on-chain offers are matched by matchOffers

OfferParallelSaleFacet.releaseParallelSa.why: the borrower unwinds its own parallel-sale binding

PositionNFT.approve(address,uint256).why: the holder's own ERC-721 approval; refused while the holder is locked

PositionNFT.cancelUnlock().why: the holder withdraws its own pending unlock

PositionNFT.executeLockDelay(address).why: applies a holder's own requested lock-delay lowering once the current delay has passed; anyone may call it and only the holder waits on it. No keeper pass backs it yet; a follow-up issue tracks one

PositionNFT.executeUnlock(address).why: applies a holder's own requested unlock once its lock delay has passed; anyone may call it and only the holder waits on it. No keeper pass backs it yet; a follow-up issue tracks one

PositionNFT.lock().why: the holder locks its own tokens; it only tightens

PositionNFT.requestUnlock().why: the holder asks to unlock its own tokens; it waits the holder's own lock delay
